text.title: 用蓝笔划掉的句子
text.situation:
诺拉用蓝笔划掉一句相当长的话，请乔换一种说法，保留日期和地点。新版更简洁，一个简明标题也让读者容易找到它。乔不确定变化的范围：是房间换了，还是只有入口换了？她们先查看地图，再修改。诺拉没有忽视这个问题；缩短文章时，很容易漏掉这一差别。旧段落的小副本留在新段落旁。减少文字有用，前提是剩下的话仍能把人引到正确的地方。

乔：路线变化到什么程度？
诺拉：只有入口换了。
乔：那我换个说法，把它讲清楚。

paragraphs.en: Nora drew a blue line through a rather long sentence. She asked Jo to paraphrase it without losing the date or the location. The new version was concise, and a succinct heading helped readers find it quickly. Jo was not sure of the extent of the change: had the room moved, or only the entrance? They checked the map before making an amendment. Nora did not ignore Jo’s question. It would have been easy to overlook the difference while shortening the text. They kept a small copy of the old paragraph beside the new one. Fewer words were useful only if the words left on the page still led people to the right place.

paragraphs.en:
Jo: To what extent has the route changed?
Nora: Only the entrance has moved.
Jo: Then I will paraphrase the sentence and make that clear.

诺拉：只有入口换了。
乔：那我换个说法，把它讲清楚。

S16.N07.P01.function: The sentence crossed out in blue
acceptableAnswers: 乔把长句换一种说法写出。 新段落简洁明了。 标题简明扼要。

S16.N07.P02.function: The sentence crossed out in blue
acceptableAnswers: 乔核查变化的范围。 诺拉修改了初稿。 诺拉没有忽视问题。

S16.N07.P03.function: The sentence crossed out in blue
S16.N07.P03.cue: 说说那个细节为什么容易漏看。
acceptableAnswers: 乔差点漏看入口的变化。 第一句话相当长。

S16.N07.T01.function: The sentence crossed out in blue
S16.N07.T01.cue: 改写这则通知，保留原意：“因维修，周一只能从侧门进入大厅。”
acceptableAnswers: 由于维修，请在周一从侧门进入大厅。
